subject: Pilot close: final-mile bump request for Novatech pilot
messages:
From: Olivia Barnes <olivia@novatech.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: procure@novatech.com
Date: 2027-10-10T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Quick ask re: pilot runway + conversion incentives

Hi Mateo,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team is excited about the latency and the cost telemetry. We’d like to extend the pilot window by another 60 days to run two additional integration scenarios with our ingestion pipeline.

Given our procurement timeline (we’re looking at a potential PO in mid-November), could Redwood extend the trial credits or provide a one-time conversion credit to help us bridge the gap? If Novatech sees an easier path to predictable costs in that window, I think we convert sooner.

High-level asks:
- 60-day pilot extension (same environment)
- One-time credits applied to a pilot/first-month invoice (to offset onboarding costs)

Happy to share a short update on success metrics if helpful.

— Olivia
Olivia Barnes
Head of Machine Intelligence
Novatech
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-10-10T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Quick ask re: pilot runway + conversion incentives (Novatech)

Vanessa / Ben — forwarding Novatech’s ask. They’re a mid-market platform with clear runway to convert if we can make the first-month economics easier. Key points: 60-day extension + a one-time conversion credit to offset onboarding.

My proposal (what I’d offer if we get sign-off):
- 60-day extension at current pilot pricing/config
- One-time credit of $12,000 applied to the first invoice after pilot conversion (covers estimated token spend and some integration effort)
- Condition: a simple success checklist (3 integration tests + uptime metric) and commitment to a 12-month contract on conversion

Attachments: novatech_pilot_scope_v2.pdf — short scope/success metrics.

Can we approve the $12k credit from promo bucket or do we need finance/legal sign-off? If $10k is the limit, I can rework.

Thanks — Mateo
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-10-10T11:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Quick ask re: pilot runway + conversion incentives (Novatech)

Mateo — thanks, this looks promising. A few notes from RevOps/Finance: 

- We have a promo bucket for EOQ support but individual approvals above $10,000 need a documented business case and payment trigger (i.e., credit applied only after invoice issuance or as a committed discount on month-1).
- If you can structure as a one-time invoice credit tied to a signed PO or SOW, finance okays up to $12,000 but we need deal paperwork before we apply it.
- Please populate the summary sheet (attached) with estimated token usage and the proposed credit application method. I attached eoquk-promo-bucket-summary.csv — add the numbers in the second tab.

If you want to go to $15k we’ll need a quick leadership review (Vanessa), but $12k is doable with the SOW/PO. Also, make sure we capture the conversion commitment in the contract (12 months) so we can amortize the credit.

— Ben
Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-10-11T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Quick ask re: pilot runway + conversion incentives (Novatech)

Appreciate the summary. I’m comfortable with a conditional $12k one-time credit provided the following are in place before any credit is applied:

1) Signed SOW or PO that references the credit amount and application approach.
2) A 12-month committed contract on conversion (minimum spend language preferred).
3) Success checklist (use the novatech_pilot_scope_v2.pdf) and CHK run sign-off from our integration team.

Mateo — go ahead and send Novatech a one-page offer with those conditions. I’ll sign off on the $12k from our promo bucket once procure/legal confirm the SOW language. If they push back, escalate to me — I can approve up to $15k if we need to win them this quarter.

— Vanessa
Director, North America Sales
Redwood Inference
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Barnes <olivia@novatech.com>
Cc: procure@novatech.com, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-10-12T17:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick ask re: pilot runway + conversion incentives (Novatech)

Olivia — thanks for the patience. We can do the 60-day extension and offer a one-time $12,000 conversion credit with the following simple conditions (below). Attaching the one-page offer and the SOW draft for your review.

Offer summary (what Redwood will provide):
- 60-day pilot extension on current infra/config (no infra change)
- One-time credit of $12,000 applied to first-month invoice after conversion (credit referenced in SOW/PO)
- Conversion commitment: 12-month minimum term on the paid agreement (we can include a minimum token spend clause if you prefer)
- Success checklist: three integration tests (ingest correctness, real-time latency under target, and KV cache stability) — checklist in novatech_pilot_scope_v2.pdf

Next steps:
1) Review attached SOW and one-page offer.
2) If it looks good, sign the SOW/return PO referencing the credit.
3) Once we receive signed SOW/PO, finance will lock the credit and apply it upon first invoice after conversion.

Forwarding internal approvals for transparency:

On Mon, Oct 10, 2027 at 11:47 AM, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com> wrote:
> Mateo — thanks, this looks promising. A few notes from RevOps/Finance: 
> 
> - We have a promo bucket for EOQ support but individual approvals above $10,000 need a documented business case and payment trigger (i.e., credit applied only after invoice issuance or as a committed discount on month-1).
> - If you can structure as a one-time invoice credit tied to a signed PO or SOW, finance okays up to $12,000 but we need deal paperwork before we apply it.
> 

Let me know if you want me to loop legal or solutions engineering on the checklist. We’re targeting a signed SOW by Friday to keep this in Q4.

Best — Mateo
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachments: novatech_pilot_scope_v2.pdf (proposal, 3 pages)
             eoquk-promo-bucket-summary.csv (filled once Mateo updates)
             signed-multiparty-sla-draft.docx (SLA template for procurement)
